import tempfile, os
from dotenv import load_dotenv, dotenv_values

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = os.path.join(d, '.env')
    with open(p, 'w') as f:
        f.write('A=hello\nB=${A}\nC=pre-${A}-post\n')
    print('interpolate=False:', dict(dotenv_values(p, interpolate=False)))
    print('default         :', dict(dotenv_values(p)))

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = os.path.join(d, '.env')
    with open(p, 'w') as f:
        f.write('A=hello\nB=${A}\n')

    print('load_dotenv False B =', os.environ.get('B'))
    os.environ.pop('B', None); os.environ.pop('A', None)

import io, os
from unittest.mock import patch
from dotenv import load_dotenv, dotenv_values

with patch.dict(os.environ, {"A": "outer"}, clear=True):
    load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("B=${A}\n"), interpolate=False)
    print("load_dotenv interpolate=False ->", os.environ.get("B"))
with patch.dict(os.environ, {"A": "outer"}, clear=True):
    load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO("B=${A}\n"), interpolate=True)
    print("load_dotenv default ->", os.environ.get("B"))
print("dotenv_values default ->", dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO("A=one\nB=${A}\n"))["B"])
print("dotenv_values False ->", dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO("A=one\nB=${A}\n"), interpolate=False)["B"])
EOF
